curated.tagline: LLM-powered study tool — auto-generates quizzes and flashcards from any source
curated.description: Study tool that uses large language models to automatically generate quizzes and flashcards from web content. Extracts key concepts from any URL, generates question-answer pairs, and presents them in an adaptive learning interface.
highlights: Automatic quiz generation from web sources

github.description: AI-powered study companion — generates flashcards, quizzes, and summaries from any topic. Web + Android with text-to-speech and export. Built with React, Node.js, and AWS Bedrock.
